info.company: Betterware de Mexico, S.A.P.I. de C.V.

about: Betterware de México, S.A.P.I. de C.V. operates as a direct-to-consumer selling company in the United States and Mexico. It operates through Home Organization Products; and Beauty and Personal Care Products segments. The Home Organization Products segment provides a portfolio of products comprising kitchen and food preservation; home solutions; bedroom; bathroom; laundry and cleaning; wellness; and technology and mobility. The Beauty and Personal Care Products segment offers fragrances, color, skin care products, and toiletries. It sells its products through catalogues, as well as distributes through a network of distributors, associates, leaders, and consultants to the end customers. Betterware de México, S.A.P.I. de C.V. is headquartered in El Arenal, Mexico. The company operates as a subsidiary of Campalier S.A. de C.V.
